narr: Slow moving thunderstorms developed across Cochise, Graham and Greenlee counties during the afternoon. Heavy rain up to 2 inches per hour caused areas of flash flooding.
ev: One to two inches of rain in less than 1 hour in the Sunsites area caused flash flooding and the closure of Birch Rd. near Highway 191.
One to two inches of rain in less than 1 hour south of San Simon caused flash flooding of roadways and resulted in the closing of Coyote Song Rd.
One to two inches of rain in less than 1 hour north of Willcox caused flash flooding of roadways and the closure of Hardy Rd.
One to two inches of rain in less than an hour caused flash flooding in the Clifton-Morenci area. One school was damaged by floodwaters.
A considerable area of more than 2 of rain fell in less than 1 hour east of Haekel Rd. in southeast Graham County. A section of the roadway was washed out by floodwaters near the Artesia Rd turnoff.
lsr: COCHISE COUNTY FIRE REPORTED BIRCH ROAD AT US 191 IMPASSABLE DUE TO FLOODING.
